author: BaconBoomer12345
body:
I have been banned for hacking, it has been a long 8 months. And yes I did hack, I used aim-bot and it was only for a laugh.
I was in a Skype call with my friends (not mentioning any names) and we went on Avicus Nexus, I thought that I would never go on this server again, so I decided to hack. My friends were aware of this and before it got out of hand one of them reported me. I was angry at him first, but then I realized he did the right thing. I am truly sorry for my actions the reason why I am writing this is appeal is because every time when I am in a Skype call with my friends and they go on Avicus I'm just sat there missing out on the fun. And I think I learned my lesson after 8 months.

Regards:
BaconBoomer12345
